entities.summary: Epaminondas José de Araújo. Filho do sr. Epaminondas José de Araújo e da sra Lídia de Araújo, was the Catholic bishop of the Diocese of Palmeira dos Índios, Brazil. Ordained a priest on 12 August 1945, de Araújo was appointed bishop on 14 December 1959 and was ordained on 27 March 1960. He served in three different dioceses in Brazil.
